game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Harbor Docks Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sailor ahead. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cargo hold by solving code steps involving cover that move the sailor forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cargo hold first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Harbor Docks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Harbor Docks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
